topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I'm sitting here, the pages of the novel scattered across the table like a puzzle I don’t want to solve. The words, so familiar yet foreign, paint a picture I never asked to see. Each sentence, crafted with a care I didn’t know my partner had, reveals secrets I thought were mine alone. The silence in the room is thick, heavy with the weight of these unspoken stories. I trace the lines with my finger, each curve and dot a reminder of moments I shared, or maybe just thought I did. Outside, the world continues, oblivious. Inside, I’m trapped in these pages, unsure if I’ll ever find my way out.
